data.gender_notes: Rajendrasinh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rajendra means 'ruler of kings', Sinh means 'lion'. So, Rajendrasinh means 'Ruler of lion-hearted kings'. The name Rajendrasinh carries the meaning “Ruler of kings” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rajendrasinh usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of kings and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage, leadership, and strength. It is believed that those named Rajendrasinh possess the power to rule their lives and the lives of others with wisdom and compassion.
data.etymology: Rajendrasinh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of kings.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajendrasinh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
